Name: Genshin Impact Plushies - Catalogue
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
So I've wanted to make a custom catalogue for my Genshin Plushies for a while, because we're already at 56 plushies and it's getting too cluttered for my liking [size=2](Sumeru is next and will make it 70 plushies, and that's only 3 out of 7 nations)[/size]. But none of those plushies include Paimon [size=2](I said I'd only do playable characters)[/size], which just can't be - she's Genshin's mascot, how could I not make her marketable? So here's the solution: she's now the catalogue!
[line]
[b][color=#ffd966][size=3][i]Features[/i][/size][/color][/b]
✨ [b]Paimon's Plushie![/b] A [b]new piece of furniture[/b] that acts as a [b]custom catalogue for all my Genshin Plushies[/b]
✨ You can buy it from [b]Robin's Shop for 1000g[/b] by default
✨ The [b]price is configurable[/b], so you can decide for how much you'll buy it [size=1](Wanna set the price to 1g so you can get it the first day? You can!)[/size]
✨ Removes all of my Genshin Plushies from the Furniture Catalogue and adds them to this one instead, so they don't clutter the former
✨ [b]i18n compatible![/b] Includes English and Spanish as of 1.0.0
[line]
[b][i][color=#ffd966][size=3]Notes Notes[/size][/color][/i][/b]
✨ [b]Currently includes:[/b]
   ✧ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38334]Mondstadt[/url]
   ✧ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39263]Liyue[/url]
   ✧ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38492]Fontaine[/url]﻿
✨ You can get the Paimon Plushie from its own catalogue, so you can get infinite free Paimons once you buy one, if you want!
✨ It is [i]not required[/i] for my plushies! This is just for anyone that wants to get them earlier [size=2](hence being able to choose the price of the catalogue)[/size] or doesn't want them taking up space in the Furniture Catalogue. Highly recommended to keep everything organized though! [size=1](Also, you want the Paimon Plushie, don't you?)
[/size]✨ If you don't have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] installed, it will just add the Paimon Plushie as a regular plushie instead of a working catalogue, so make sure to get it! [size=1](...yeah i forgot to add it as a requirement in the manifest and i don't feel like updating it just for that right now, sorry ^^')[/size][line]
[color=#fff2cc][size=2]Lil note that I won't work on mods until Christmas holidays - there's too much going on at university for it.
But on an unrelated note- I GOT DURIN AND VENTI'S NEW BOW !!![/size][/color][line]
